observationsNotFindings: OBL-G20-NAMED-CATALOG's reason says slashJoinerVerbatim and surfacesInOrder 'are carried on this join at the same field paths'. Strictly the field NAMES match but the full paths differ: the catalog nests them at classes[0].slashJoinerVerbatim / classes[0].surfacesInOrder, while the join carries them at top level. I tested this as a possible mis-description and it does not rise to a finding: both values are byte-identical to the catalog's, the field names are identical, a join measuring a single corpus class has nowhere else to put them, and the purpose of the CLAUDE-G20CAT-V1-SF1 landing — keeping the eight surfaces as one slash-joined set rather than eight classes — is fully served. Byte-identical to the ACCEPTed v4.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-two attacks run, twenty-two refuted. The subject is a genuine remeasurement of frozen join v4 onto live HEAD efc7fe5 / file 08 f909ddff / required-now 28, with file 08 confirmed moved; the nine-obligation leftoverDesign set is provably identical. This cycle has two artifacts labelled v4 — the frozen predecessor join and the contract — and the subject disambiguates them consistently. The reservation surface holds: reservedVerbatim is exactly list-equal to the contract's six reserved members, and a sweep for concrete languages, frameworks, and API styles finds nothing. The CLAUDE-G20CAT-V1-SF1 guard holds too: slashJoinerVerbatim, surfacesInOrder, and memberVerbatim are each byte-identical to the catalog's, keeping the eight surfaces as one class rather than eight. Owners are attributed precisely by scope, with the DR-125 row owner and the DR-G20 gate owner each matching their live cell exactly. One imprecision logged as an observation: 'the same field paths' describes matching field names whose full paths differ by a classes[0] prefix — the values are byte-identical and the guard's purpose is served. Note for contrast with the prior cycle: this artifact's doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone enumerates both leftovers completely, so no under-report risk carries into D-184.
